### 2. AI Disclosure & Governance (Module 12 Compliance)

### 3. Engineering Safety & Verification Checklist
- [ ] **Pre-commit Linter Passed:** Ran `py ai_precommit_security_linter.py` with 0 defects.
- [ ] **Interrupt Preemption Audit:** Emergency Stop EXTI priority remains strictly at Priority 0.
- [ ] **No Blocking Calls in ISR:** Confirmed absence of `HAL_Delay()` or busy wait loops in all `_IRQHandler` routines.
- [ ] **DMA Memory Safety:** Shared buffers between DMA and CPU core are marked `volatile`.
- [ ] **Physical Hardware Verification:** Tested on physical dev bench / prototype board with oscilloscope / logic analyzer.
